{"tool":"python","code":"from openpyxl.styles import PatternFill, Alignment

ws = wb.active
print("sheet:", ws.title, "dims:", ws.dimensions)

# 1) Formulaic transposition in H2:S28:
#    For rows where B=1 (race start), pull sequential G values from consecutive rows,
#    limited by C (runner count); blanks stay blank.
for r in range(2, 29):
    f = ('=IF($B{r}=1,IF(COLUMN()-COLUMN($H$2)+1<=$C{r},'
         'IF(INDEX($G$2:$G$28,ROW()+COLUMN()-COLUMN($H$2)-1)="", "",'
         'INDEX($G$2:$G$28,ROW()+COLUMN()-COLUMN($H$2)-1)),""),"")').format(r=r)
    for c in range(8, 20):  # H..S
        ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value = f

# 2) Shade H2:S28 with #E2EFD and remove decimals for whole values
fill = PatternFill(start_color="E2EFD", end_color="E2EFD", fill_type="solid")
for r in range(2, 29):
    for c in range(8, 20):
        cell = ws.cell(row=r, column=c)
        cell.fill = fill
        cell.number_format = "0.##"

# 3) Center align all cells to the right of column G (H..AD, rows 1..28)
al = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for r in range(1, 29):
    for c in range(8, 31):
